requirements_summary: Customer builds IntelliJ/PyCharm plugin that runs a local indexer against monorepos and streams completions to the IDE. Must support: local/VPC-only index storage, streaming token-by-token low-latency completions (<50ms 95th ideally), model pinning and safe rollback, per-route cost/latency telemetry, and offline dev mode. Preference for quantized model variants to reduce infra cost. Plugin must be eligible for JetBrains marketplace distribution without leaking repo contents.
